svg.title: Disclosure, trademark, TCPA & concentration guardrails
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-compliance-and-scrub-guardrail-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Disclosure, trademark, TCPA & concentration guardrails; subtitle: Mandatory pre-flight checks before activating traffic on any offer; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numbers identify sequential operating checks enforced prior to live click routing.; caption: Eliminate retro-clawbacks and account bans by enforcing FTC disclosures, TM+ riders, S2S deduplication, and <=25% merchant caps.; stages: label: FTC 255 above fold?; value: Check 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Plain-English material connection notice appears above first CTA on 390px mobile, desktop, and video.; label: TM+ or brand negs?; value: Check 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Either signed written TM+ co-bidding addendum on file or account-level partner brand negatives active.; label: TCPA / statutory clean?; value: Check 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Zero federal healthcare % kickbacks (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b); Seller-specific consent + TrustedForm on calls/leads.; label: S2S + <=25% cap?; value: Check 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: HMAC S2S postback verified with >=2 fallback offers live so no merchant exceeds 25% of portfolio revenue.

circle.title: label: FTC 255 above fold?; value: Check 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Plain-English material connection notice appears above first CTA on 390px mobile, desktop, and video.

text.title: Plain-English material connection notice appears above first CTA on 390px mobile, desktop, and video.

circle.title: label: TM+ or brand negs?; value: Check 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Either signed written TM+ co-bidding addendum on file or account-level partner brand negatives active.

text.title: Either signed written TM+ co-bidding addendum on file or account-level partner brand negatives active.

circle.title: label: TCPA / statutory clean?; value: Check 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Zero federal healthcare % kickbacks (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b); Seller-specific consent + TrustedForm on calls/leads.

text.title: Zero federal healthcare % kickbacks (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b); Seller-specific consent + TrustedForm on calls/leads.

circle.title: label: S2S + <=25% cap?; value: Check 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: HMAC S2S postback verified with >=2 fallback offers live so no merchant exceeds 25% of portfolio revenue.

text.title: HMAC S2S postback verified with >=2 fallback offers live so no merchant exceeds 25% of portfolio revenue.
Assumptions: Numbers identify sequential operating checks enforced prior to live click routing.
